newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Cagamas accepts 1-month notes at average 6.463 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cagamas accepts 1-month notes at average 6.463 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's national mortgage corporation Cagamas Bhd announced on Monday it accepted bids at an average discount of 6.463 percent at its auction of one-month notes for 150 million ringgit.
Cagamas also said it accepted bids at an average discount of 6.482 percent at its auction of three-month notes for 800 million ringgit.

The corporation said it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.799 percent at its auction of three-year Tier 1 bonds for 500 million ringgit, above the 450 million it was originally tendering out for.
Total amount bidded for the one-month notes was 590 million ringgit and 1.79 billion ringgit for the three-month notes.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.491/416 percent for the one-month notes, and 6.528/400 percent for the three-month notes, Cagamas said.
For the bonds, bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.810/776 percent.
